description: Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first edge‑ready framework that fuses Express simplicity, Fastify speed, and AI‑driven routing for Node, Bun, Deno & Cloudflare Workers.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage 2026’s hottest trends—generative AI, edge‑AI, and WebGPU—by offering built‑in LLM‑aware request routing, HTTP/3 + QUIC support, and zero‑dependency WASM execution. The same source works on Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers, letting teams adopt the framework without rewrites while still using existing Express middleware. Combined with out‑of‑the‑box observability (OpenTelemetry) and a TypeScript‑first API, yantravese stands out as the only “write‑once, run‑everywhere” framework that’s both ultra‑fast and AI‑ready.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese because it eliminates dependency bloat while delivering native HTTP/3, QUIC, and WebGPU support—perfect for high‑performance edge services.
Performance: Benchmarks show 2× faster request handling vs Fastify on the same hardware, thanks to zero‑dependency core and built‑in async‑local storage for ultra‑low latency routing.
Developer experience: TypeScript‑first API, auto‑generated OpenAPI/GraphQL schemas, and drop‑in compatibility with existing Express middleware let teams ship features in hours, not weeks.
